api_accounting.independent_validation: 97 confirmed queries, 1 historical inconclusive excluded. Queries share the TMDb authority; no catalogue-wide false-positive estimate.

coverage_scope: All association/coverage figures describe reviewed proposals and isolated databases. Actual live has 5095 discoveries and zero canonical associations.

live_rollout.guard: Guarded migrations then checksum/exact-target confirmed offline import only after separate explicit live authorization
live_rollout.known_preexisting_live_issue: Backend was already restarting; logs report missing tracker_cataloguediscoverystate.heartbeat_at on live head 0053. Live schema not modified. Clone guarded migrations resolve the schema prerequisite.
live_rollout.rollback: Restore the checksummed fresh pre-rollout dump after stopping writers; rehearse restoration and compare all rows before reopening writes.

validation.harness: PostgreSQL test_canonical_scale; runner uses PYTHONPATH=/app/scripts and temporary Compose test-file mounts, matching docker-compose.test.yml. Initial harness-only missing-file/import failures corrected; no tests suppressed.

proof_expiration_policy: Manifest import fails closed when any embedded proof expires; no automatic refresh or retries of ambiguous records.
